q: Shannon entropy is used in decision tree learning (e.g., ID3 algorithm) to select features by maximizing:
opts: Information gain = H(Y) − H(Y|X) (reduction in label entropy after observing feature X)
The mutual information I(X;X) between features
exp: Information gain measures how much knowing feature X reduces uncertainty about label Y: IG(Y;X) = H(Y) − H(Y|X) = I(X;Y). ID3 greedily selects the feature with highest information gain at each node.
